title: hieracium ferroviae
intro: Hieracium ferroviae, commonly known as the railway hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the daisy family. This plant is rich in various bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Hieracium ferroviae include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful for wound healing and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to stimulate the immune system and exert protective effects on the liver and kidneys.
